content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00210 When a SW-C in an untrusted partition receives (OUT parameter) or provides (IN parameter with composite data type) an ArgumentDataPrototype or Variable- DataPrototype , it hands over a pointer to a memory object to an RTE API. The RTE shall only forward this pointer to a trusted SW-C after it has checked that the whole memory object is owned by the caller’s partition.
